description: The Mosaic Company is the world's leading producer and marketer of concentrated phosphate and potash crop nutrients, and through its broad product offering it is a single source supplier of phosphate- and potash-based crop nutrients and animal feed ingredients, serving customers in approximately 40 countries. It is the second largest integrated phosphate producer in the world and one of the largest producers and marketers of phosphate-based animal feed ingredients in North America and Brazil, the leading fertilizer production and distribution company in Brazil, mining phosphate rock in Florida, Brazil and Peru and processing rock into finished phosphate products at facilities in Florida, Louisiana and Brazil, and is typically one of the top four global potash producers in the world, mining potash in Saskatchewan and New Mexico, with other production, blending or distribution operations in Brazil, China, India and Paraguay, and its operations serve the top four nutrient-consuming countries in the world.
